patch_description: This crossover retains the stronger equilateral-triangle construction, multiple symmetry-broken seed families, directed bottleneck-gradient proposals, and strict maximin polishing from the current implementation. It improves internal efficiency by precomputing incident-triangle masks, vectorizing bottleneck-gradient computation, avoiding repeated mask allocation, and replacing the expensive full soft-min exponential calculation with a deterministic lower-tail ranking score. The strict smallest triangle area remains the primary selection criterion, while the weighted lower tail resolves ties and improves robustness against exchanging one limiting triangle for another.
